avatar_file_name.description: File name of the uploaded avatar.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to the vehicle.

VehicleStatusListing.description: One entry in the vehicle status list.

order.description: Position of the status. **Ignored on update**, where position comes from the array order.

ServiceTaskConditions.description: When the service work falls due. **At least one of `mileage`, `date`, or `engine_hours` must be given.**

limit.description: Mileage limit in kilometres.

notification_interval.description: How far before the limit to start notifying.

repeat_interval.description: Interval for the repeated task, when `repeat` is true.

end.description: Date and time the work falls due.

notification_interval.description: How many days before the date to start notifying.

repeat_interval.description: Interval for the repeated task, when `repeat` is true.

engine_hours.description: Fall due at an engine-hours reading.

limit.description: Engine-hours limit.

notification_interval.description: How far before the limit to start notifying.

repeat_interval.description: Interval for the repeated task, when `repeat` is true.

ServiceTaskNotifications.description: Where notifications about this service work are sent.

sms_phones.description: Phone numbers to notify by SMS.

ServiceTask.description: A service work scheduled against a vehicle.

id.description: ID of the service work. Omit when creating.

description.description: Name of the service work. Up to 255 characters.

status.description: Current status. `created` is the initial state, `notified` means a condition passed its notification limit, `expired` means a condition was exceeded, `done` means the user marked it complete.

repeat.description: If `true`, a new task is created when this one is done.

unplanned.description: If `true`, the work is unplanned. For information only.

cost.description: Cost in the currency of the user. For information only.

completion_date.description: Date the service work was completed.

start.description: Counter values when the task was created.

allOf.description: Date and counter values when the task was marked done.

file_ids.description: IDs of attached files. One file may be attached to several service works, so deleting one task does not delete a shared file.

prediction.description: **Legacy, no longer used.** Controlled by the `return_prediction` parameter on the list and download operations.

FileUploadTarget.description:
Where to upload a reserved file, and what to send with it. Shared by the service work and task form file operations.

`fields` varies with the storage backend: internal storage returns a single `token`, while Amazon S3 returns the policy, key, signature and encryption headers that the upload must carry.

file_id.description: ID of the reserved file. Submit it as the value of the record it belongs to: a service work, or a form field.

url.description: URL to POST the multipart upload to.

expires.description: When this upload target stops being valid.

file_field_name.description: Name to use for the file field in the upload request.

fields.description: Additional fields to send with the upload. Send these before the file part, which must be last.

Bill.description: A bill raised against the user's account.

sum.description: Bill sum, in the default currency of the panel.

status.description: Bill order status. `created` means raised but not settled.

positions.description: Position names. A bill raised through `bill/create` carries exactly one.

PaymentSystem.description:
A payment system available to the user, with the settings its dealer configured.

The object is open: a payment system may return further properties specific to its type. `prices`, a map of product code to price, appears for `ios_inapp`. Stripe adds the `auto_payment_min`, `auto_payment_threshold_min` and `auto_payment_monthly_min` limits. Yandex adds `merchant_receipt_required` and, when that is set, `merchant_receipt`.

type.description: Payment system type.

url.description: URL to send payment information to.

account.description: Optional. The dealer's account in the payment system, which is the eshopId for RBK and the merchant code for 2Checkout.

subscription_code.description: Subscription code. For 2Checkout, formerly Avangate, this is the same as `payment_code` but for subscriptions.

methods.description: Optional. Available payment methods. May be empty.

min_payment.description: Optional. Smallest amount this payment system accepts.

max_payment.description: Optional. Largest amount this payment system accepts.

auto_payments_enabled.description: Whether automatic payments are switched on for this payment system.

Plan.description: A device plan, called a tariff in older parts of the API.

name.description: The plan's label.

group_id.description: Group of plans. A user can only switch to a plan in the same group.

active.description: `true` when users may switch to this plan on their own. A user can only switch to an active plan.

type.description: Plan type. The published prose omits `every_year`.

price.description: Price per month for a `monthly` or `everyday` plan, or price per active day for an `activeday` plan.

early_change_price.description: Price of changing from this plan to another when the last change was less than the freeze period ago, 30 days by default under the `tariff.freeze.period` config option. **Absent when the user may not change plan early**, in which case frequent changes are refused outright.

device_limit.description: Maximum number of devices per account on this plan.

paas_free.description: `true` when this plan is free for the PaaS owner.

store_period.description: Data storage period, such as `2h` for two hours, `3d` for three days, `5m` for five months, or `1y` for one year.

auto_prolong.description: Whether the plan renews automatically. Not documented in the published object description.

features.description: Features this plan makes available to the user.

map_filter.description: Which maps the user may use.

exclusion.description: When `true` the maps in `values` are the ones **not** available. When `false` they are the only ones available.

values.description: Map types the filter applies to.

Transaction.description: One billing transaction on the user's account.

description.description: Transaction description.

type.description: Type of transaction.

user_id.description: ID of the user who made the transaction.

tracker_id.description: Tracker ID, or 0 when the transaction is not associated with a tracker.

amount.description: Amount of money in the transaction. Can be negative: -10.0000 means 10 units were taken off the balance.

new_balance.description: The user's money balance after the transaction.

old_balance.description: The user's money balance before the transaction.

bonus_amount.description: Amount of bonus used in the transaction. Can be negative.

new_bonus.description: The user's bonus balance after the transaction.

old_bonus.description: The user's bonus balance before the transaction.

JournalLocation.description: A point with an address. Unlike a depot location it carries no radius.

DriverJournalEntry.description:
A categorised trip in the driver journal.

On create, everything except `id`, `employee_id`, `comment` and the two odometer values is required, and `id` must be absent. On update only `id`, `type` and `comment` may be sent, and every other field is rejected.

id.description: ID of the entry. Absent when creating.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker, also known as the object ID. Must belong to the current account and not be blocked.

start_date.description: Start date and time of the entry.

end_date.description: End date and time of the entry. Must be after `start_date`.

employee_id.description: ID of the employee driving. Must exist when given.

type.description: Type of the entry.

length.description: Length of the trip, in kilometres.

Garage.description: A depot: where vehicles are kept and maintained, with the people responsible for them.

id.description: Depot ID. Absent when creating, required when updating.

location.description: Optional. Where the depot is. Omitted from a response when the stored location is not valid.

mechanic_name.description: Name of the mechanic. **Required**, up to 255 characters.

dispatcher_name.description: Name of the dispatcher. **Required**, up to 255 characters.

organization_name.description: Name of the organization. **Required**, up to 255 characters.

Task.description: A task: a place to visit, a window to visit it in, and the conditions that decide whether it was done.

id.description: Primary key. Used when updating; **ignored when creating**.

user_id.description: ID of the owning user, the office. **Read-only.**

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker this task is assigned to. **Ignored on update**, where reassignment goes through a separate operation.

location.description: The circular geofence for this task. Entering and leaving it are what the platform watches. Cannot be null.

address.description: Address of the location. Set this to associate the task with an address.

radius.description: Radius of the zone in metres, from 1 to 300000.

label.description: Name of the task. 1 to 200 characters, and not blank.

description.description: Description of the task. Up to 1024 characters. **Required**, but may be an empty string.

from.description: Date after which the zone must be visited.

to.description: Date before which the zone must be visited. Required, and cannot be in the past.

external_id.description: Free text tying this record to an external system, such as an order number. 1 to 100 characters. For reference only.

status.description: Current status. **Ignored on create and update.** `arrived` means the performer reached the geofence without completing the task, and `faulty` means it completed with problems.

status_change_date.description: When the status last changed. **Ignored on create and update.**

max_delay.description: Maximum allowed completion delay, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_stay_duration.description: Minimum time that must be spent inside the zone for completion, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_arrival_duration.description: Visits shorter than this do not count as an arrival, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000. Not listed in the published object description.

arrival_date.description: When the tracker reached the zone, or null if it has not. **Read-only.**

origin.description: How this record was created. **Ignored on create and update.** `imported` means it came from a spreadsheet.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to this record.

type.description: Which kind of record this is.

form.description: The attached form, when there is one.

form_template_id.description: ID of a form template. Read on create and update **only when `create_form` is `true`**.

fields.description: Custom field values. Each key is a custom field ID **as a string**, and each value carries the field `type` and its `value`.

files.description: Files associated with this record. **Read-only**, and not listed in the published object description.
