TaskCheckpoint.description:
A checkpoint: one stop on a route. It carries every field a task does, plus its position in the route.

A checkpoint inherits its performer from its route, so `tracker_id` is ignored on update.

id.description: Primary key. Used when updating; **ignored when creating**.

user_id.description: ID of the owning user, the office. **Read-only.**

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker this checkpoint is assigned to. **Ignored on update**, where reassignment goes through a separate operation.

location.description: The circular geofence for this checkpoint. Entering and leaving it are what the platform watches. Cannot be null.

address.description: Address of the location. Set this to associate the task with an address.

radius.description: Radius of the zone in metres, from 1 to 300000.

label.description: Name of the checkpoint. 1 to 200 characters, and not blank.

description.description: Description of the checkpoint. Up to 1024 characters. **Required**, but may be an empty string.

from.description: Date after which the zone must be visited.

to.description: Date before which the zone must be visited. Required, and cannot be in the past.

external_id.description: Free text tying this record to an external system, such as an order number. 1 to 100 characters. For reference only.

status.description: Current status. **Ignored on create and update.** `arrived` means the performer reached the geofence without completing the checkpoint, and `faulty` means it completed with problems.

status_change_date.description: When the status last changed. **Ignored on create and update.**

max_delay.description: Maximum allowed completion delay, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_stay_duration.description: Minimum time that must be spent inside the zone for completion, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_arrival_duration.description: Visits shorter than this do not count as an arrival, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000. Not listed in the published object description.

arrival_date.description: When the tracker reached the zone, or null if it has not. **Read-only.**

origin.description: How this record was created. **Ignored on create and update.** `imported` means it came from a spreadsheet.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to this record.

type.description: Which kind of record this is.

form.description: The attached form, when there is one.

form_template_id.description: ID of a form template. Read on create and update **only when `create_form` is `true`**.

fields.description: Custom field values. Each key is a custom field ID **as a string**, and each value carries the field `type` and its `value`.

files.description: Files associated with this record. **Read-only**, and not listed in the published object description.

parent_id.description: ID of the route this checkpoint belongs to.

order.description: Zero-based position of this checkpoint within its route.

TaskHistoryEntry.description: One recorded change to a task.

user_id.description: ID of the user the task belongs to.

task_id.description: ID of the task this entry belongs to.

payload.description: Depends on the operation. Typically the fields that changed: a full task for `create`, a diff for `update`, and the new status for `status_change`.

ExternalIdCounts.description: How many records share each `external_id` involved in this call, so a caller can spot a duplicate. Present only when the record carries an `external_id`.

count.description: How many records now carry it.

from.description: Start of the range.

to.description: End of the range.

FormFile.description: A file attached to a form field.

storage_id.description: ID of the storage holding the file.

type.description: What kind of file this is.

created.description: When the file record was created.

uploaded.description: When the file was uploaded, or null if it has not been.

name.description: File name.

size.description: Size in bytes. For a file that is not uploaded yet, the maximum size allowed for the upload.

metadata.description: Metadata for the file. For an image this carries `orientation`, the EXIF orientation.

state.description: Where the file is in its lifecycle.

download_url.description: URL the file is available at, or null if it is not uploaded yet.

bindings.description: Every entity this file is linked to. For a form field this carries `form_field` with `form_id`, `field_id` and `submitted`.

previews.description: Preview images for the file. May be null or empty for any file in any state.

FormListEntry.description: One form in the list, with the records it relates to.

task.description: The task the form belongs to: `id`, `label`, `from`, `to`, `creation_date`, `arrival_date`, `address`, `status`, `completion_date`, and `fact_duration`, how long the performer actually spent on it as an ISO 8601 duration.

employee.description: The employee who submitted it, when there is one.

tracker.description: The tracker involved, when there is one.

vehicle.description: The vehicle involved, when there is one.

submit_places.description: Where the form was submitted, and which places and geofences that location falls in. May be null.

location.description: Where the form was submitted.

places.description: Places containing the submission location. May be empty.

zones.description: Geofences containing the submission location. May be empty.

TaskRoute.description: A route: a named, ordered set of checkpoints. A route is complete when every checkpoint is complete and they were visited in order; otherwise it completes with warnings or fails.

id.description: Primary key. Used when updating; **ignored when creating**.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker this route is assigned to. **Ignored on update**; use `task/route/assign`.

label.description: Name of the route. 1 to 200 characters, and not blank.

description.description: Description of the route. Up to 1024 characters. **Required**, but may be an empty string.

from.description: Date after which the first checkpoint zone must be visited. **Ignored on create and update**: it is taken from the first checkpoint.

to.description: Date before which the last checkpoint zone must be visited. **Ignored on create and update**: it is taken from the last checkpoint.

external_id.description: Free text tying this route to an external system. 1 to 100 characters.

status.description: Current status. **Ignored on create and update.**

status_change_date.description: When the status last changed. **Ignored on create and update.**

origin.description: How this route was created. **Ignored on create and update.**

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to the route.

checkpoint_ids.description: IDs of the route checkpoints, in order of execution. **Ignored on create.** On update, reordering this array changes the order of execution.

type.description: Always `route`.

ScheduleParameters.description: When a schedule fires. `type` selects which of the two forms applies, and the matching array must not be empty.

type.description: Which form this is. `weekdays` repeats on days of the week, `month_days` on days of the month.

weekdays.description: Days of the week to create tasks on, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday. Used when `type` is `weekdays`.

month_days.description: Days of the month to create tasks on, from 1 to 31. Used when `type` is `month_days`.

TaskScheduleEntry.description: A recurring task. Very like a task, except that the specific `from` and `to` of a task are replaced by `from_time`, `duration` and `parameters`, which together say when each generated task runs.

id.description: Primary key. Used when updating; **ignored when creating**.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker every task generated from this schedule is assigned to. Null leaves them unassigned.

description.description: Description. Up to 1024 characters. **Required**, but may be an empty string.

location.description: The circular geofence for the generated task. Cannot be null.

radius.description: Radius of the zone in metres, from 1 to 300000.

from_time.description: Time of day at which the generated task starts, as `HH:MM:SS`.

duration.description: Total duration in minutes between the generated task's `from` and `to`. From 1 to 46080, which is 32 days.

max_delay.description: Maximum allowed completion delay, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_stay_duration.description: Minimum time that must be spent inside the zone for completion, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_arrival_duration.description: Visits shorter than this do not count as an arrival, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to this schedule.

form_template_id.description: ID of a form template to build a form from on each generated task. Nullable.

fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by custom field ID as a string. Not listed in the published object description.

type.description: Which kind of schedule this is. **Read-only**, and not listed in the published object description.

files.description: Files associated with this schedule. **Read-only**, and not listed in the published object description.

RouteScheduleEntry.description: A recurring route. It carries no location or timing of its own: those live on its checkpoint schedules.

id.description: Primary key. Used when updating; **ignored when creating**.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker every task generated from this route schedule is assigned to. Null leaves them unassigned.

description.description: Description. Up to 1024 characters. **Required**, but may be an empty string.

CheckpointScheduleEntry.description: One stop on a recurring route. It carries the location and timing that a route schedule does not, and takes its firing days from its parent route schedule rather than holding `parameters` of its own.

id.description: Primary key. Used when updating; **ignored when creating**.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker every task generated from this checkpoint schedule is assigned to. Null leaves them unassigned.

description.description: Description. Up to 1024 characters. **Required**, but may be an empty string.

parent_id.description: ID of the route schedule this checkpoint schedule belongs to.

order.description: Zero-based position within the route schedule.

location.description: The circular geofence for the generated task. Cannot be null.

radius.description: Radius of the zone in metres, from 1 to 300000.

from_time.description: Time of day at which the generated task starts, as `HH:MM:SS`.

duration.description: Total duration in minutes between the generated task's `from` and `to`. From 1 to 46080, which is 32 days.

max_delay.description: Maximum allowed completion delay, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_stay_duration.description: Minimum time that must be spent inside the zone for completion, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

min_arrival_duration.description: Visits shorter than this do not count as an arrival, in minutes. Default 0, up to 512000.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to this checkpoint schedule.

form_template_id.description: ID of a form template to build a form from on each generated task. Nullable.

fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by custom field ID as a string.

Place.description:
A point of interest: a business-specific place such as a shop, delivery point or warehouse that employees visit.

POIs can carry custom fields. A POI with a custom field of type "responsible employee" appears in the Mobile Tracker App for the employee it names.

icon_id.description: Optional. ID of the assigned icon, 1 to 255. **Cannot be set here**: use `place/avatar/assign`.

avatar_file_name.description: Optional. Name of the uploaded avatar file, set by `place/avatar/upload`.

location.description: Where the POI is. Required.

address.description: Address of the POI. Required, up to 255 characters.

radius.description: Radius of the POI in metres. Required, 1 to 300000.

fields.description: Optional. Custom field values, keyed by custom field ID **as a string**.

description.description: Optional. Description of the POI.

tags.description: Optional. IDs of tags applied to the POI. Non-empty when present.

external_id.description: Optional. Free text tying this POI to an external system. Up to 32 characters.

files.description: Files associated with the POI. **Read-only**, and not listed in the published object description.

CheckedPlace.description: A POI parsed from a batch, with the same fields as a POI plus any per-row problems found while checking it.

icon_id.description: Optional. ID of the assigned icon, 1 to 255. **Cannot be set here**: use `place/avatar/assign`.

avatar_file_name.description: Optional. Name of the uploaded avatar file, set by `place/avatar/upload`.

location.description: Where the POI is. Required.

address.description: Address of the POI. Required, up to 255 characters.

radius.description: Radius of the POI in metres. Required, 1 to 300000.

fields.description: Optional. Custom field values, keyed by custom field ID **as a string**.

description.description: Optional. Description of the POI.

tags.description: Optional. IDs of tags applied to the POI. Non-empty when present.

external_id.description: Optional. Free text tying this POI to an external system. Up to 32 characters.

files.description: Files associated with the POI. **Read-only**, and not listed in the published object description.

errors.description: Optional. Problems found in this row.

tag_names.description: Optional. Tag names of the POI, as written in the batch.

ImportProcess.description:
A background import of records from a preloaded TSV file.

**One shape, shared by every import family**: places, vehicles, employees, zones and the rest all return this object, differing only in `type`.

user_id.description: ID of the master user the import belongs to.

subuser_id.description: ID of the sub-user who started the import. Not listed in the published object description.

created.description: When the import process was created.

type.description: What is being imported.

params.description: The import parameters, as given when it was started.

headers.description: What each column of the file holds, in order.

user_headers.description: Optional. Display labels for the columns.

filename.description: Name of the preloaded TSV file being imported.

status.description: Where the import is. `created` is waiting to start, `done` finished on its own, `failed` could not complete, and `finished` was closed by the user.

progress.description: How far the import has got.

failed.description: Rows that did not pass validation.

ImportLineMessage.description: One problem found in the imported file, tied to the line it was found on.

Form.description: A filled-in or fillable form. A form is created from a template and used once: after submission it is kept with its values for reference and cannot be reused.

description.description: Form description. May be empty.

fields.description: The form fields. See the form fields and values reference for the shape of each type.

created.description: When this form was created, or attached to its task. **Read-only.**

submit_in_zone.description: When `true`, the form can only be submitted inside the task zone.

task_id.description: ID of the task this form is attached to.

checkin_id.description: ID of the check-in this form belongs to, when it came from one.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker involved.

template_id.description: ID of the template this form was built from. **Null when that template has been deleted.**

template_version.description: Version of the template at the time this form was created.

values.description: The submitted values, keyed by field ID. **Null when the form has not been filled in.** See the form fields and values reference.

submitted.description: When the values were last submitted.

submit_location.description: Where the values were last submitted.

FormTemplate.description: A reusable set of form fields. Each form is issued from a template, and changing a template afterwards does not alter forms already issued from it.

description.description: Template description. May be empty or null.

version.description: Auto-incrementing version number, raised on every modification.

fields.description: The template fields. See the form fields and values reference for the shape of each type.

updated.description: When this template was last modified. **Read-only.**

submit_in_zone.description: When `true`, forms from this template can only be submitted inside the task zone.

default.description: When `true`, this template is chosen by default for every new task that takes a form.

Employee.description: A person working at the organization: an employee or a driver. Employees can be linked to trackers, vehicles and places.

id.description: Internal ID. May be null or absent when creating.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker currently assigned to this employee. Null means none.

first_name.description: First name. **Cannot be empty.** Up to 100 characters.

middle_name.description: Middle name. May be empty but **not null**. Up to 100 characters.

last_name.description: Last name. May be empty but **not null**. Up to 100 characters.

email.description: Email address, which must be valid when given. May be empty but **not null**. Up to 100 characters.

phone.description: Phone number **without the leading `+`**. May be empty but not null. Up to 32 characters.

driver_license_number.description: Driver licence number. May be empty but not null. Up to 32 characters.

driver_license_cats.description: Driver licence categories. Up to 32 characters.

driver_license_issue_date.description: Issue date of the driver licence, as `yyyy-MM-dd`.

driver_license_valid_till.description: Date the driver licence is valid until, as `yyyy-MM-dd`.

hardware_key.description: Hardware key, such as an iButton or RFID identifier. Up to 64 characters.

icon_id.description: ID of the assigned icon. **Cannot be set here**: use `employee/avatar/assign`.

avatar_file_name.description: Name of the uploaded avatar file. **Cannot be set here**: use `employee/avatar/upload`.

department_id.description: ID of the department this employee belongs to.

location.description: Optional. Location associated with this employee. Must be a valid location or null.

radius.description: Radius in metres around that point.

personnel_number.description: Optional. Personnel number. Up to 15 characters.

ssn.description: Optional. Social security number. Up to 32 characters.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to the employee.

CheckedEmployee.description: An employee parsed from a batch, with the same fields as an employee plus any per-row problems found while checking it.

id.description: Internal ID. May be null or absent when creating.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker currently assigned to this employee. Null means none.

first_name.description: First name. **Cannot be empty.** Up to 100 characters.

middle_name.description: Middle name. May be empty but **not null**. Up to 100 characters.

last_name.description: Last name. May be empty but **not null**. Up to 100 characters.

email.description: Email address, which must be valid when given. May be empty but **not null**. Up to 100 characters.

phone.description: Phone number **without the leading `+`**. May be empty but not null. Up to 32 characters.

driver_license_number.description: Driver licence number. May be empty but not null. Up to 32 characters.

driver_license_cats.description: Driver licence categories. Up to 32 characters.

driver_license_issue_date.description: Issue date of the driver licence, as `yyyy-MM-dd`.

driver_license_valid_till.description: Date the driver licence is valid until, as `yyyy-MM-dd`.

hardware_key.description: Hardware key, such as an iButton or RFID identifier. Up to 64 characters.

icon_id.description: ID of the assigned icon. **Cannot be set here**: use `employee/avatar/assign`.

avatar_file_name.description: Name of the uploaded avatar file. **Cannot be set here**: use `employee/avatar/upload`.

department_id.description: ID of the department this employee belongs to.

location.description: Optional. Location associated with this employee. Must be a valid location or null.

radius.description: Radius in metres around that point.

personnel_number.description: Optional. Personnel number. Up to 15 characters.

ssn.description: Optional. Social security number. Up to 32 characters.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to the employee.

errors.description: Optional. Problems found in this row.

Department.description: A group of employees, with an optional location.

location.description: Optional. Location associated with the department. Must be a valid location or null.

radius.description: Radius of the zone in metres.

Checkin.description: A check-in: a point in time and space recorded by a field employee from the Mobile Tracker App, with an optional comment, photos and a filled form.

marker_time.description: When the check-in was created. Never null.

user_id.description: ID of the master user. Never null.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker that created this check-in. Never null.

employee_id.description: Optional. ID of the employee assigned to that tracker.

location.description: Where the check-in was made. Never null.

precision.description: Accuracy of the fix in metres. Note this is `precision`, not the `radius` used elsewhere.

comment.description: Optional. A comment provided by the app user.

files.description: Files attached to the check-in. Never null, may be empty.

form_id.description: ID of the form sent with the check-in.

form_label.description: Label of the form sent with the check-in.

Subuser.description:
An additional user with access to the master account, scoped to a subset of its trackers and limited by a security group.

Almost identical to a normal user. A sub-user owns nothing exclusively: every tracker, rule and task it creates belongs to the master account. The one exception is reports, where each sub-user has its own pool and schedule.

id.description: Sub-user ID. May be null when creating.

activated.description: `true` when the sub-user is allowed to log in.

login.description: Sub-user email, used as the login. Must be a valid and unique email address.

first_name.description: First name of the sub-user or contact person.

middle_name.description: Middle name of the sub-user or contact person.

last_name.description: Last name of the sub-user or contact person.

post_country.description: Country part of the postal address.

post_index.description: Index part of the postal address.

post_region.description: Region part of the postal address.

post_street_address.description: Street part of the postal address.

registered_country.description: Country part of the registered address.

registered_index.description: Index part of the registered address.

registered_region.description: Region part of the registered address.

registered_street_address.description: Street part of the registered address.

state_reg_num.description: State registration number, such as an EIN in the USA or an OGRN in Russia. Up to 15 characters.

tin.description: Taxpayer identification number, also called a VATIN or INN.

iec.description: Optional. Industrial Enterprises Classifier, also called a KPP. Used in Russia, for `legal_entity` only.

security_group_id.description: ID of the security group this sub-user belongs to. **Null means the default group, which has no rights at all.**

creation_date.description: When the sub-user was created. **Read-only**, and should not be sent on update.

SecurityGroup.description:
A named set of rights that can be given to sub-users.

Most read operations need no right at all, so a sub-user in the default group can still read, subject to scoping. Most data-changing operations do need one.

id.description: Group ID. May be null when creating.

rights.description: Rights granted to the group. **`admin` cannot be granted**: it belongs to master users only.

store_period.description: Optional. How far back the group may view history, in the legacy duration format: `2h` for two hours, `3d` for three days, `5m` for five months, `1y` for one year.

Plugin.description: A software module that changes how certain API calls behave, such as which tracker registration flows or report types are available.

type.description: Plugin type, such as `tracker_register` or `tracker_report`.

ui_module.description: Name of the plugin's UI module.

filter.description: Which device models this plugin applies to.

exclusion.description: When `true`, `values` lists the models **not** supported. When `false`, it lists the only ones supported.

values.description: Regular expressions matching device model names.

parameters.description: Plugin-specific parameters. **Omitted when null**, which it usually is.

ApiKey.description:
A credential equivalent to a session hash but with unlimited lifetime, intended for one integration each.

**Treat it as a secret.** It can perform almost any action on the account, and it travels in cleartext, so calls must go over HTTPS.

hash.description: The key itself, 32 characters. Send it as `Authorization: NVX <hash>`.

title.description: Title given to the key, so it can be told apart from the others.

DealerUiSettings.description: How a dealer monitoring interface should present itself. Returned to an unauthenticated caller, so it carries branding and defaults but no account data.

service_title.description: Name of the service, shown in the interface.

maps.description: Map types available to this dealer users.

default_map.description: Which map to show, and where, before the user has chosen.

type.description: Default map type.

location.description: Where the map is centred by default.

currency.description: The dealer currency, as an ISO 4217 code.

payment_link.description: Link a user can follow to top up their account. Depends on the PaaS, and may be null or empty.

google_client_id.description: Client ID for working with the Google API, or null.

favicon.description: Path or URL to the interface favicon.

logo.description: Path or URL to the logo.

app_logo.description: Path or URL to the mobile app logo.

login_wallpaper.description: Path or URL to the login page wallpaper.

desktop_wallpaper.description: Path to the interface wallpaper, or null.

monitoring_logo.description: Path to the monitoring page logo, or null.

login_footer.description: Footer included on the login page. HTML special characters are escaped as entities.

allow_registration.description: True when self-registration is available to this dealer users.

show_mobile_apps.description: True when mobile applications are offered to this dealer users.

show_call_notifications.description: True when call notifications are available.

measurement_system.description: Measurement system to present values in.

display_model_features_link.description: True to show a link to squaregps.com in the device model information.

color_theme.description: Colour theme code, or an empty string for the default theme.

app_color_theme.description: Mobile app colour theme code, or an empty string for the default theme.

privacy_policy_link.description: Privacy policy link. May be null or empty.

tos.description: Terms of service text. May be null or empty.

tracker_model_filter.description: Which device models may be registered.

exclusion.description: When true, the models in `values` are excluded rather than being the only ones allowed.

values.description: Model names the filter applies to. An empty list means every model is available.

light_registration.description: When true, use the simplified registration flow with a demo tracker.

demo_tracker_source_id.description: ID of the tracker created by light registration.

demo_tracker_label.description: Label of the tracker created by light registration.

no_register_commands.description: When true, do not send configuration commands to devices on activation.

HistoryEntry.description: One recorded event: a rule firing, a device going offline, a task changing state, and so on.

type.description: Kind of device the event came from.

is_read.description: `true` when the user has seen the notification and it has been marked read.

message.description: Notification message, **shortened to 256 characters**. The untruncated text is in `extra.full_message` when it was shortened.

event.description: Event type. The available values come from `history/type/list`.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker, also known as `object_id`.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule that produced the event, when there was one.

track_id.description: ID of the track the event happened on, or 0 when no track is associated.

address.description: Street address of `location`, repeated here for convenience. Null when the event carries no location.

location.description: Where the event happened.

precision.description: Accuracy of the fix in metres.

address.description: Human-readable address of the point, or an empty string when none was resolved. **Nested here, not at the top level of the entry.**

assets.description: Assets linked to the event, each naming an identifier and a type. Present on entries the platform could associate with a vehicle or an employee.

type.description: What kind of asset it is.

extra.description: Event-specific extras. Which of these appear depends on the event type.

employee_full_name.description: Full name of the employee the event relates to. Added by the history service when it can resolve one.

vehicle_label.description: Label of the vehicle the event relates to. Added by the history service when it can resolve one.

parent_task_id.description: Related parent task ID, for a task checkpoint event.

last_known_location.description: `true` when the location may be out of date.

emergency.description: `true` for an emergency event, matching the same flag on the rule.

proximity_object_id.description: ID of the tracker involved in a proximity event.

employee_id.description: ID of the driver at the time of the event.

full_message.description: The full event message, present when `message` was shortened.

precision.description: Precision of the location in metres.

command.description: Present on a `command_sent` event: a command dispatched from a tracker's Commands block.

name.description: Name of the command that was sent.

param.description: Value substituted for the command's `<>` placeholder, when it has one.

response.description: Delivery result. A `hardware` command populates only `success`; an `http` command populates `status` and `body` (and `error` in place of them when the request itself failed) instead, leaving `success` absent.

status.description: HTTP status code returned by the destination endpoint. Present only for an `http` command.

body.description: Raw response body from the destination endpoint, truncated to fit the event's storage limit. Present only for an `http` command.

error.description: Error message, up to 256 characters, when the request to the destination endpoint could not be completed. Present only for an `http` command, and only when the request failed.

success.description: Whether the command was sent to the device. Present only for a `hardware` command.

Tag.description: A label used to find things quickly. Tags can be applied to place, task, task_schedule, employee, vehicle, zone, tracker.

avatar_file_name.description: Optional. File name of the uploaded avatar, with extension. **Cannot be set here**: use `tag/avatar/upload`.

name.description: Name of the tag.

color.description: Tag colour, as a three-byte RGB hex value such as `FF0000`.

CustomField.description:
A custom field added to an entity, so records of that entity can carry information the platform does not define.

The `type` fixes what the field accepts and **cannot be changed** once the field exists.

id.description: Field identifier. **Null when creating**, which is how a new field is signalled.

label.description: Name of the field. Must be unique among the fields of one entity.

type.description: What the field holds. `text` takes up to 700 Unicode characters. `bigtext` takes up to 20000 but has reduced search and sorting. `email` and `phone` are validated as such. `decimal` runs from -999999999999.999999 to 999999999999.999999 and stores six decimal places. `integer` runs from -2^63 to 2^63-1. `employee` links to an employee and is the only type taking `params`.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled in.

description.description: Additional information about the field, up to 512 characters.

params.description: Type-specific parameters. **Omit when the type needs none**, which is every type except `employee`.

responsible.description: For an `employee` field. When `true`, records carrying this field can be shown to that employee in the Mobile Tracker App. **Only one employee field per entity may set this.**

CustomizableEntity.description:
A class of records whose presentation and editable fields can be customized, such as places.

Which rights govern an entity depends on its type, so an account may see an entity in `entity/list` that it cannot read.

type.description: Which class of records this is. A plain account carries `place` and `task`; the published prose names only `place`.

settings.description: How records of this entity are presented.

layout.description: How the fields are laid out. **Must account for every field of the entity**, built-in and custom, with none omitted and none repeated.

sections.description: The sections the fields are grouped into. At least one section must exist.

field_order.description: The fields in this section, in order. Built-in fields by name, custom fields by ID **as a string**. For `place` the built-in names are `label`, `location`, `tags` and `description`.

ReportTimeFilter.description: Which part of each day, and which days of the week, the report should cover.

from.description: Start time of day, such as `00:00:00`.

to.description: End time of day, such as `23:59:59`.

weekdays.description: Days of the week to include, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday.

ReportDescriptor.description: A generated or in-progress report, with the parameters it was generated from.

id.description: Report ID, used to retrieve, download or delete it.

from.description: Start of the reporting period, as given to `generate`.

to.description: End of the reporting period, as given to `generate`.

percent.description: How ready the report is, as a percentage.

type.description: What kind of report this is.

parameters.description: The parameters the report was generated from.

trackers.description: Trackers the report covers.

plugins.description: Parameters of every plugin used to generate the report.

include_places_in_address.description: Whether place names are prepended to addresses in this report.

include_zones_in_address.description: Whether geofence names are prepended to addresses in this report.

locale_info.description: The locale, timezone and measurement system the report was rendered with.

ReportBody.description:
A generated report, rendered as data rather than as a file.

The outer structure is the same whatever plugin produced the report: a report holds sheets, a sheet holds sections, and a section is either a table or a block of text. **What varies by plugin is the column set**, so the cells inside a row are keyed by column name and are not fixed here.

from.description: Start of the reporting period.

to.description: End of the reporting period.

sheets.description: The sheets of the report, normally one per tracker or per entity covered.

header.description: Sheet heading, such as the employee and vehicle it covers.

entity_ids.description: IDs of the entities this sheet covers.

additional_field.description: Extra text carried with the sheet. Often empty.

sections.description: The sections making up the sheet.

ReportSection.description: One block of a report sheet. `type` says which shape it takes: a `table` carries `columns` and `data`, while a `text` block carries `rows` and a `style`.

type.description: What kind of section this is.

style.description: Rendering style for a text section, such as `small_print`.

columns.description: Column definitions, for a table section. The `field` of each column is the key its cells use in a row.

field.description: Key this column uses in a row object.

title.description: Column heading as rendered, which may contain a line break.

weight.description: Relative weight used when laying the table out.

highlight_min_max.description: Whether the smallest and largest values in this column are highlighted.

column_groups.description: Groupings applied over the columns. Often empty.

data.description: The table body, in groups. Each group carries its own `header` and a list of rows.

header.description: Heading for this group of rows, such as a date.

rows.description: The rows. **Each row is keyed by column `field` name**, so its properties depend on the plugin. Every cell is a `ReportCell`.
Summary rows, for a text section. Unlike table rows these are a flat list, each naming what it measures.

name.description: What this row measures, such as "Total trips length, km".

v.description: The value as rendered for display.

raw.description: The same value unformatted, for calculation.

ReportCell.description: One cell of a report table. **`v` is for display and `raw` is for calculation**: `v` is already formatted to the report locale and units, while `raw` carries the underlying number or timestamp.

v.description: The value as rendered for display.

raw.description: The same value unformatted: a number, or a timestamp in milliseconds.

type.description: What kind of cell this is, such as `value`.

location.description: Where the value happened, on cells that carry a position.

ReportScheduleEntry.description: A report that is generated regularly and emailed.

enabled.description: Whether the scheduled report is active.

parameters.description: What to generate, how often, and where to send it.

period.description: How much time each report covers: `Xm` for months, `w` for a week, `d` for a day, `y` for a year.

type.description: Which form the schedule takes.

weekdays.description: Days of the week to fire on, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday.

month_days.description: Days of the month to fire on, from 1 to 31.

report.description: The report to generate. Takes the same fields as `report/tracker/generate`, except the period, which comes from `period` above. Includes `include_places_in_address` and `include_zones_in_address`, both defaulting to `true`.

emails.description: Optional. Addresses to send the report to.

email_format.description: Format to send the report in.

sending_time.description: Optional. Default `00:00:00`. Local time to send at, to **hourly granularity**.

fire_time.description: When the schedule last fired. **Ignored on create and update.**

last_result.description: How the last generation went. **Ignored on create and update.**

success.description: Whether the last report generated successfully.

id.description: ID of the report that was generated.

Zone.description:
A geofence: an area used to limit where a rule applies, and named after the address in reports when an event happens inside it.

**One object, three shapes, selected by `type`.** A `circle` has `center` and `radius`. A `polygon` has `points`. A `sausage` has `points` and a `radius`, and covers everything within that distance of the polyline.

type.description: Which shape this geofence is, and therefore which of the fields below apply. **Cannot be changed** once the geofence exists.

color.description: Geofence colour, as a three-byte RGB hex value. Optional on create and update, defaulting to `27A9E3`.

radius.description: Radius in metres. **For `circle` it is the circle radius; for `sausage` it is the distance from the polyline. A `polygon` has no radius.**

points.description: The geofence points. **`polygon` and `sausage` only**, and returned only when the operation was asked for them. On create they go in a separate `points` parameter instead.

bounds.description: North-west and south-east corners of the axis-aligned minimum bounding box.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to the geofence.

CheckedZone.description: A circle geofence parsed from a batch, with the same fields as a geofence plus any per-row problems found while checking it. `id` is null, since nothing was created.

type.description: Which shape this geofence is, and therefore which of the fields below apply. **Cannot be changed** once the geofence exists.

color.description: Geofence colour, as a three-byte RGB hex value. Optional on create and update, defaulting to `27A9E3`.

radius.description: Radius in metres. **For `circle` it is the circle radius; for `sausage` it is the distance from the polyline. A `polygon` has no radius.**

points.description: The geofence points. **`polygon` and `sausage` only**, and returned only when the operation was asked for them. On create they go in a separate `points` parameter instead.

bounds.description: North-west and south-east corners of the axis-aligned minimum bounding box.

tags.description: IDs of tags applied to the geofence.

errors.description: Optional. Problems found in this row, present only when something is wrong.

parameter.description: Which parameter was wrong, such as `zone.center`.

ZonePoint.description: One point of a polygon or sausage geofence. A circle geofence has no points.

node.description: `true` when this point is a route node.

AssetId.description: A reference to an asset, by ID and kind.

type.description: What kind of asset it is.

AssetGroup.description: A group of assets, holding at most one asset of each type.

name.description: Name of the group.

assets.description: Assets in the group. May be empty.

AssetGroupObject.description: One asset and the group it belongs to. Used to report assignments that were removed or that block a reassignment.

Track.description:
One track: a period of movement reconstructed from the points a device sent. The same object serves tracker tracks and asset tracks. **`type` selects which fields are present**, and the four kinds are not interchangeable.

`regular` is an ordinary trip. `single_report` appears when the device reports in interval mode or only one point exists, and has no end or length. `merged` is every track in the period combined, returned only when `split` was `false`. `cluster` is a group of single-point trips gathered by coordinate, returned only when `cluster_single_reports` was `true`.

id.description: Track ID. Present on `regular` and `single_report`, absent on `merged` and `cluster`.

type.description: Which kind of track this is.

start_date.description: Track start, in the user's time zone. On `single_report` it is when the point was registered.

end_date.description: Track end, in the user's time zone. Absent on `single_report`.

end_address.description: Address at the end. Absent on `single_report` and `cluster`.

length.description: Track length in kilometres. Absent on `single_report` and `cluster`.

points.description: **One field name, two meanings, decided by `type`.** On `regular` and `merged` it is an integer, the total number of points in the track. On `cluster` it is a plain list of coordinates, the points gathered into the cluster, which is not the same thing as `points_list`. Absent on `single_report`.

oneOf.description: Total number of points in the track. `regular` and `merged`.
The coordinates gathered into this cluster. `cluster` only.

max_speed.description: Highest speed recorded, in km/h. Absent on `single_report` and `cluster`.

avg_speed.description: Average speed in km/h. Absent on `cluster`.

event_count.description: Events recorded during the track. **Absent unless `count_events` was `true`.**

norm_fuel_consumed.description: Fuel consumed during the track, in litres. **Absent when no vehicle is linked to the tracker, or the vehicle has no `norm_avg_fuel_consumption`.**

precision.description: Accuracy of the location in metres. Present on `single_report` and `cluster`, and depends on the device model.

gsm_lbs.description: Optional. GSM LBS flag. On a `cluster` it is `true` only when every point in it is GSM LBS.

points_list.description: The track points. **Returned only when `with_points` was `true`.**

bounds.description: North-west and south-east corners of the axis-aligned minimum bounding box.

TrackPoint.description: One point recorded by a tracker, timestamped when the tracker recorded it and shown in the user's time zone.

satellites.description: How many GPS satellites fixed this point.

get_time.description: GPS timestamp of the point, in the user's time zone.

address.description: Address at the point, or an empty string when none was recorded. **An address is recorded only at the start or end of a trip, or where an event happened.**

heading.description: Direction in degrees, 0 to 360, where 0 is North.

precision.description: Optional. Accuracy in metres. Depends on the device model.

gsm_lbs.description: Optional. `true` when the location came from GSM LBS rather than GPS.

parking.description: Optional. `true` when the point is not part of a trip. Which points count as parking depends on the platform's parking detection settings.

buffered.description: Optional. `true` when the point was held in the device's memory and sent later. Varies by tracker model.

ApnSettings.description: Mobile-internet access point settings for a SIM, together with the operator they belong to.

name.description: APN name, for example `internet`.

user.description: APN user name. Empty when the operator needs none.

password.description: APN password. Empty when the operator needs none.

operator_name.description: Name of the mobile operator the number belongs to.

BeaconDataEntry.description: One scan of a BLE beacon by a tracker: which tag was seen, how strongly, and where the tracker was at the time.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker that saw the beacon, also known as the object ID.

rssi.description: Received signal strength indicator, in dBm. Values closer to zero mean the beacon was nearer the tracker.

get_time.description: When the scan was recorded, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.

latitude.description: Latitude of the tracker at the time of the scan.

longitude.description: Longitude of the tracker at the time of the scan.

ext_data.description: Additional values the beacon reported. Contents depend on the beacon type: an iBeacon reports `major` and `minor`, a sensor beacon may report `voltage` and `temperature`.

GeoBounds.description: A bounding box, given by its north-west and south-east corners.

AddressDetails.description: An address broken into its parts. Returned only when `with_details` is set, and each part is present only when the geocoder resolved it.

bounds.description: Optional. The smallest box that fully contains the result.

GeocodedLocation.description: One result of a forward geocoding search: a point and the address at it.

MapLayer.description: A user-supplied KML overlay shown on the map. This object is the metadata only; the KML body is read separately.

id.description: Map layer ID. Read-only, assigned on upload, and required when updating.

label.description: Name of the layer. Trimmed, and cannot be empty.

Retranslator.description: A forwarding rule that sends the data devices report to the platform on to a third-party server.

id.description: Retranslator ID. Read-only, assigned on creation, and required when updating.

name.description: Name of the retranslator. 1 to 64 characters, trimmed.

protocol_id.description: ID of the protocol to forward with, from `retranslator/protocols/list`.

address.description: Network address of the receiving server, such as `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`. 1 to 255 characters, trimmed.

login.description: Optional unless the protocol requires it. 1 to 64 characters, trimmed.

password.description: Optional unless the protocol requires it. 1 to 64 characters, trimmed. **Returned in clear text by `retranslator/list`.**

RetranslatorProtocol.description: A forwarding protocol the platform can retranslate with, and the credential rules it imposes.

name.description: Protocol name, for example `EGTS` or `Wialon IPS`.

classname.description: Internal name of the handler implementing the protocol. Read-only, and of no use to callers.

has_login.description: `true` when the protocol uses a login at all.

has_password.description: `true` when the protocol uses a password at all.

required_login.description: `true` when a retranslator on this protocol cannot be saved without a login.

required_password.description: `true` when a retranslator on this protocol cannot be saved without a password.

fake_device_id_pattern.description: Regular expression the substitute device ID must match, or `null` when the protocol does not constrain it.

WorkingStatus.description: One entry in a status list: an activity a tracker can be marked as being in, such as busy or on a break.

id.description: Working status ID. Read-only, assigned on creation, and required when updating.

label.description: Human-readable label. 1 to 200 printable characters, trimmed, and cannot be blank.

color.description: Display colour as six hexadecimal digits, **without a leading `#`**, for example `E57373`.

StatusChange.description: One change of a tracker's working status, recording what it changed from and to, where, and who changed it. May be `null` where a tracker's status has never changed.

old_status_id.description: The status held before the change, or `null` when none was set.

new_status_id.description: The status held after the change, or `null` when the status was removed, which happens when the tracker is moved to a different status list.

location.description: Where the tracker was when the status changed, or `null` when the location was unknown.

address.description: Address at that point, or an empty string when none was resolved.

changed.description: When the change was recorded, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.

origin.description: Who made the change: `supervisor` from the monitoring interface, `employee` from the Mobile Tracker App.

TrackerCurrentStatus.description: A tracker's working status as it stands now, with the change that produced it.

current_status.description: The status the tracker holds now, or `null` when none is set.

LocationLinkLifetime.description: When a geo link is valid. Both ends are optional: with neither, the link never starts pending and never expires.

from.description: Optional. When the link becomes usable, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format. Before this the link sorts as pending.

to.description: Optional. When the link expires, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.

LocationLinkTracker.description: One tracker on a geo link, and what the link reveals about it.

tracker_id.description: ID of the tracker.

alias.description: Optional. Name to show instead of the tracker label, so the recipient need not see internal naming. At most 100 characters.

params.description: What the link shows for this tracker.

object_data.description: Which pieces of information to reveal. Empty means location only.

sensor_ids.description: Optional. IDs of the tracker's sensors whose readings the link shows.

state_fields.description: Optional. Names of tracker state fields the link shows.

counters.description: Optional. Counter types the link shows.

LocationLinkParams.description: What a geo link shows besides the trackers themselves, and how the map is presented.

bounding_zone_ids.description: Geofences that bound where the link reports a position. At most 100.

bounding_mode.description: How the bounding geofences apply: `inside` reports a position only within them, `outside` only beyond them. Optional when there are no bounding geofences.

place_ids.description: Places to draw on the link's map. At most 100.

place_custom_field_ids.description: Custom fields of those places to show. Each must be a custom field of the place entity type.

zone_ids.description: Geofences to draw on the link's map. Distinct from `bounding_zone_ids`, which restrict reporting rather than decorate the map. At most 100.

LocationLinkDisplayOptions.description: How the shared map looks to the person opening the geo link.

map.description: Base map to show, for example `roadmap`, `satellite`, `hybrid` or `osm`. Which values work depends on the maps available to the account, so the platform does not validate this.

autoscale.description: Default `true`. Fit the map to the trackers shown.

trace_duration.description: Default 5. How long, in seconds, the trailing trace behind each tracker remains visible. 0 shows no trace.

LocationLink.description: A geo link: a shareable session showing the live location of chosen trackers to someone without a platform account.

id.description: Geo link ID. Read-only, assigned on creation, and required when updating.

hash.description: The session hash that identifies the link to whoever it was shared with. Read-only.

create_date.description: When the link was created, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format. Read-only.

creator_id.description: ID of the user who created the link. Read-only.

enabled.description: Whether the link is currently active. Read-only here; change it with `tracker/location/link/status/change`.

description.description: Description of the link. At most 255 printable characters, and may be empty.

lifetime.description: When the link is valid, or `null` for no limit at either end.

trackers.description: The trackers the link shows. 1 to 100 entries.

StatusListing.description: A named set of working statuses that can be assigned to trackers. Different trackers can carry different lists.

id.description: Status list ID. Read-only, assigned on creation, and required when updating.

label.description: Human-readable label. 1 to 200 printable characters, trimmed, and cannot be blank.

employee_controlled.description: When `true`, employees may change their own working status, for example from the Mobile Tracker App.

supervisor_controlled.description: When `true`, supervisors may change the status, for example from the monitoring interface. `status/tracker/assign` returns error 13 when this is `false`.

entries.description: IDs of the working statuses in this list, **in display order**. Rejected on creation, required on update, and on update must be exactly the statuses already in the list.

RoutePoint.description: A geographic point on a route.

RouteKeyPoint.description: One of the points the caller asked for, located within the returned route.

id.description: Index of this point within the route's `list`.

distance.description: Length of the route from the start up to this point, in metres. 0 at the start.

time.description: Duration of the route from the start up to this point, in seconds. 0 at the start.

length.description: Sum of all track lengths, in kilometres.

trip_duration.description: Total time spent moving, as an ISO 8601 duration.

parking_duration.description: Total time spent stationary, as an ISO 8601 duration. Measured across the whole requested period, so it includes the gaps before the first track and after the last.

norm_fuel_consumed.description: Fuel consumed across all tracks, in litres. Omitted entirely when no track carries a figure.

TagBinding.description: A tag attached to a tracker.

tag_id.description: ID of the tag. Unique within a tracker.

ordinal.description: Position or kind of the tag. Unique within a tracker, maximum 5.

TrackerSource.description: The physical device behind a tracker.

device_id.description: Device ID, also called the source IMEI. Its accepted shape depends on the model's `id_type`.

blocked.description: `true` when the tracker is blocked because its tariff ended.

status_listing_id.description: ID of the working status list assigned to this tracker, or null.

tariff_end_date.description: Date of the next tariff prolongation, `YYYY-MM-DD`, or null.

phone.description: Phone number of the device. Null or empty when the device has no GSM module, or uses a bundled SIM whose number is hidden from the user.

Tracker.description: A tracking device registered in the platform. One of the central objects of this API.

id.description: Tracker ID, also known as the object ID.

clone.description: `true` when this tracker is a clone of another.

group_id.description: Tracker group ID, `0` when the tracker is in no group.

avatar_file_name.description: Avatar file name. Present only when the tracker has one.

tag_bindings.description: Tags attached to the tracker. Returned by `tracker/list`, and by the registration and replacement calls.

TrackerOutput.description: A named digital output on a tracker.

SensorValue.description: The last reading of one sensor. Returned by the `get_fuel`, `get_readings` and `get_diagnostics` calls, which differ only in which sensors they select.

name.description: Name of the sensor's raw input. The full set is available from `tracker/sensor/input_name/list`.

type.description: Type of quantity the sensor measures.

value.description: Reading, in the units named by `units_type`.

units_type.description: Unit of measurement of the sensor input.

units.description: User label for the sensor's units.

converted_units_type.description: Unit of the measurement system the user prefers, from their account settings. Null when no conversion is needed, meaning `units_type` already belongs to that system.

converted_value.description: The reading in `converted_units_type`. Null when no conversion is needed.

TrackerInputState.description: A semantic input bound to a digital input.

type.description: One of the predefined semantic input types.

name.description: User-defined name for the semantic input, or null.

input_number.description: Number of the associated discrete input.

TrackerInputInfo.description: Digital and semantic input state for one tracker.

inputs.description: State of every digital input. `[true, true, false]` means inputs 1 and 2 are on and input 3 is off.

states.description: Semantic inputs bound to those digital inputs.

update_time.description: When this data was last updated.

TrackerState.description: Current state of a tracker: GPS, GSM, inputs, outputs and movement.

gps.description: Last known GPS fix. Note that `lat` and `lng` sit inside `location`, not directly on this object.

updated.description: When the coordinates were last updated, in the account timezone, or null when never.

signal_level.description: GPS signal level as a percentage, or null when the device cannot report it.

location.description: The coordinates themselves.

precision.description: Precision in metres. Present only for some devices.

gsm_lbs.description: `true` when the location came from GSM LBS rather than GPS. Present only when it applies.

movement_status_update.description: When the movement status last changed, or null.

ignition.description: State of the vehicle's ignition sensor, real or virtual. Present only for devices that report it.

ignition_update.description: When the ignition state last changed. Present only alongside `ignition`.

gsm.description: GSM status. Null for devices that cannot report it.

updated.description: When the GSM status was last updated, or null.

signal_level.description: GSM signal level as a percentage, or null.

roaming.description: Roaming state, or null when the device cannot report it.

last_update.description: When the device state was last updated, or null.

battery_level.description: Battery level as a percentage, or null when the device cannot report it.

battery_update.description: When the battery level was last updated, or null.

inputs_update.description: When the inputs were last updated, or null.

outputs_update.description: When the outputs were last updated, or null.

additional.description: Additional state values. Which keys appear depends on the tracker model, and the object is empty for devices that report none. `hardware_key` is the last scanned driver identification key.

actual_track_update.description: When the device last moved, meaning when its track was last extended.

TrackerModel.description: An integrated tracker model and what it supports. Returned by `tracker/list_models`.

code.description: Model text code, the value passed as `model` when registering.

parent_code.description: Code of the parent model, or null.

type.description: Device category.

name.description: Human-readable model name.

id_type.description: How the device is identified at registration. See the identifier types on the page.

id_namespace.description: Namespace the identifier belongs to. Undocumented on the page, returned by the API.

has_phone.description: `true` when the device has a phone number.

has_apn_settings.description: `true` when the device has APN settings.

register.description: `true` when the model is available for registration.

has_auto_registration.description: `true` when the device can be registered by automatic commands from the platform.

check_bundle.description: `true` when registration checks the device against a bundle. Undocumented on the page, returned by the API.

port.description: Port to connect to on the tracking server. Null when the model supports none, or supports several, in which case read `connection`.

battery.description: The device's internal battery, used to convert a raw reading into a percentage.

low_charge.description: Level at which the low-battery rule fires.

satellites.description: `true` when the device reports a satellite count.

gsm_level.description: `true` when the device reports GSM signal strength.

gsm_network.description: `true` when the device reports the GSM network name.

gsm_roaming.description: `true` when the device reports roaming state.

has_detach_button.description: `true` when the device has a detaching sensor.

has_fuel_input.description: `true` when the device has a fuel sensor.

track_control.description: How track recording is controlled on the device. Undocumented on the page, returned by the API.

special_control.description: Additional device-specific control types, comma separated when there are several.

multimedia.description: `true` when the device supports multimedia. Undocumented on the page, returned by the API.

sms_control.description: SMS control commands this model supports.

connection.description: Ways this model can connect to the platform. Present for models that offer more than a bare port.

url.description: Full connection details: scheme, host, port and any credentials.

description.description: Connection details in prose, such as the login and topic to use.

has_led_control.description: `true` when the device supports switching an LED.

has_location_request.description: `true` when a location can be requested by SMS.

has_gprs_location_request.description: `true` when a location can be requested over GPRS.

has_gsm_lbs_location_request.description: `true` when a GSM LBS location can be requested over GPRS.

has_chat.description: `true` when chat is available for this model.

has_custom_fields.description: Default `false`. `true` when the model's protocol transmits field names, which allows a custom `input_name` to be set on its sensors.

has_odometer.description: `true` when the device has an integrated odometer.

has_lbs.description: `true` when the device sends cell information.

has_motion_sensor.description: `true` when the device has an integrated motion sensor.

has_hardware_key.description: `true` when the device can identify a driver by hardware key.

additional_fields.description: Descriptions of the model-specific fields a user fills in at registration.

group_id.description: Tracker group ID, `0` when the tracker is in no group.

SpecialSettings.description:
One special-settings object. Its `type` decides which further fields it carries, and the full catalogue of types is on the special settings page rather than here, because the set is long and model-specific.

Note that `device_status_settings`, carrying `offline_timeout_seconds`, is returned by the API but is missing from that catalogue.

type.description: Which kind of special settings this object holds, for example `electronic_lock_password` or `time_shift`.

ChatMessage.description: One chat message between a supervisor and a device.

update_time.description: Delivery time, for outgoing messages. Null until delivered.

type.description: Direction of the message.

employee_id.description: Employee the message is associated with, or null.

TrackerCommand.description: A reusable command defined on a tracker. The shape of `config` follows `type`: a `hardware` command sends a protocol string to the device, an `http` command sends a POST request to a URL.

id.description: Command ID, assigned by the server. Read-only.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the Commands block.

type.description: Which kind of command this is.

config.description: Configuration for the command, shaped by `type`.

command.description:
The exact protocol-level string sent to the device. Valid values are device-specific; consult the manufacturer's documentation, because an incorrect string can have unintended effects.

May contain a single `<>` placeholder, whose value the caller supplies as `param` on execute.

reliable.description: When `true` the platform waits for the device to acknowledge delivery before marking the command sent.

url.description: Endpoint that receives the POST request.

headers.description: Headers to send. May be empty.

body.description:
JSON payload for the POST body. `{{attribute_name}}` placeholders are replaced with live device values at execution time.

May also contain a single `<>` placeholder, which is a different mechanism: its value is supplied per call as `param` on execute rather than read from the device.

Counter.description: A tracker counter and how its raw source is scaled.

type.description: Which counter this is.

multiplier.description: Factor applied to the raw source value.

CounterValue.description: The last known value of one counter.

type.description: Which counter this is.

update_time.description: When the value was last updated.

Contact.description: Another user who shares tracker locations with this account.

user_id.description: ID of the user the contact is established with.

trackers.description: The contact's trackers whose locations are shared with this account.

TrackerGroup.description: A tracker group. Groups organise trackers in the interface; the function is purely visual.

id.description: Group ID, assigned by the server. Read-only.

color.description: Group colour in web format without a leading `#`. Sets the colour of the group's tracker markers on the map.

RetranslatorBinding.description: A binding between a tracker and a retranslator, which forwards the tracker's data to a third-party server.

fake_device_id.description: Optional. When set, the retranslator forwards this value instead of the real device ID.

SensorReading.description: The last reading of one metering sensor.

units.description: Units the value is measured in.

name.description: Raw input name behind the sensor.

type.description: Metering sensor type.

units_type.description: Unit of measurement of the sensor input.

update_time.description: When the value was last updated.

min_value.description: Lower bound of the sensor range. Present for sensors that declare one.

max_value.description: Upper bound of the sensor range. Present for sensors that declare one.

converted_units_type.description: Units the value was converted into for the account's measurement system, or null when no conversion was needed.

converted_value.description: The converted value, or null when no conversion was needed.

composite_sensor_ids.description: IDs of composite sensors this one feeds into. Present only when it feeds any.

StateReading.description: The last value of one state field.

value.description: The value. Its type follows the field and may be string, number, boolean or null.

update_time.description: When the value was last updated.

VirtualSensorReading.description: The last reading of one virtual sensor.

value.description: The reading, always a string for virtual sensors.

type.description: Virtual sensor type.

update_time.description: When the value was last updated.

TrackerReadings.description: Everything a tracker last reported: metering sensors, state fields, virtual sensors and counters.

RuleScheduleInterval.description: One window during which a rule is active. A `weekly` interval repeats every week and uses weekday and time; a `fixed` interval runs once between two timestamps.

type.description: Which kind of interval this is.

from.description: Start of the window. For `weekly`, an object with `weekday` (1 to 7) and `time`; for `fixed`, a timestamp string.

to.description: End of the window, in the same shape as `from`.

interval_id.description: Interval ID, assigned by the server.

Rule.description:
A rule: the conditions under which the platform logs an event and notifies someone.

**Note the asymmetry on geofences.** Requests take `zone_ids`, an array; responses return `zone_id`, a single integer that is `0` when the rule is not bound to a geofence.

name.description: Rule name.

type.description: One of the predefined rule types. The rule types page lists them and the extra parameters each takes.

description.description: Free-text description.

zone_id.description: Geofence the rule is bound to, or `0` when it is bound to none. **Responses only**; send `zone_ids` when writing.

zone_ids.description: Geofences to bind the rule to. **Requests only**; responses return `zone_id` instead. Leave empty for a rule that works everywhere. Not allowed for the `offline` type, and required for `route` and `inoutzone`.

trackers.description: Trackers the rule applies to.

param.description: A general-purpose integer parameter whose meaning follows `type`.

emergency.description: Whether notifications are marked as emergency, with distinct colour and sound.

auto_created.description: `true` when the platform created the rule itself. Present only on such rules.

schedule.description: Windows during which the rule is active. Omit for a rule that is always active.

extended_params.description: Parameters specific to this rule `type`. The rule types page documents them per type.

CalibrationPoint.description: One point on a sensor's calibration curve, mapping a raw reading to a real-world value. An analogue fuel sensor, for instance, reports volts that have to become litres.

Sensor.description: A sensor on a tracker. `type` selects which of three shapes this is: a **metering** sensor reads a continuous quantity, a **discrete** input reads an on/off line, and a **virtual** sensor derives a value from another input rather than measuring anything itself.

type.description: Which kind of sensor this is.

name.description: Sensor name.

sensor_type.description: The sensor's subtype, drawn from a different set for each `type`. Metering: `fuel`, `temperature`, `rpm`, `custom`, `fuel_consumption`, `instant_consumption`, `power`, `speed`, `flow_meter`, `acceleration`. Discrete: `ignition`, `sos_button`, `power`, `engine`, `car_alarm`, `door`, `charge`, `detach`, `custom`. Virtual: `virtual_ignition` or `state`.

input_name.description: Source input field name. Metering and virtual sensors only.

divider.description: Divider applied to the raw value. Metering sensors only.

accuracy.description: Rounding accuracy, in steps of 0.25. Metering sensors only.

units_type.description: Unit of measurement. Metering sensors only.

group_type.description: Aggregation method for this metering sensor when grouped. `sum` adds the values of grouped sensors; `avg` averages them. Required (non-null) for composite sensors; defaults to `sum` for non-composite metering sensors. Only meaningful on sensors of `type` `metering`.

custom_field_name.description: Default `false`. Whether `input_name` is a value the user typed rather than one the protocol defines. Only meaningful when the tracker model reports `has_custom_fields`.

parameters.description:
Extra settings, which differ by `type`.

Metering sensors take `parent_ids` and `volume` for composites, `min` and `max` bounds on the raw value, `max_lowering_by_time` and `max_lowering_by_mileage` to cap legitimate drops, and `ignore_drains_in_move`, `ignore_refuels_in_move` and `refuel_gap_minutes` to control fuel event detection during movement.

Virtual sensors take `calc_method`, one of `in_range`, `identity` or `bit_index`; `range_from` and `range_to` for `in_range`, at least one of which is required; `bit_index` for `bit_index`; and up to 100 `value_titles`, each a unique `value` with a display `title`.

SensorInputName.description: One sensor input or state field, with its description translated into the account's language.

input_name.description: The identifier, the same value a sensor's `input_name` takes.

description.description: Human-readable description in the account's language.

value.description: The reading. Double, integer or string depending on the sensor.
